jobs.name: Brief - Morning
jobs.prompt:
Produce a polished Morning Brief.

The measured brief context (weather, infra scan, reminders) is injected above under the "===== BRIEF CONTEXT =====" header. Treat that as your ONLY source for weather, infra, and reminders.

HARD RULES
- Weather: report only values present in the injected context. If it says WEATHER SOURCE UNAVAILABLE, write "outlook unavailable". Never invent or generalize a forecast.
- Infra: only call something down if the scan prints a red cross. Entries under "Known-inactive by design" are NOT issues and must not be reported as down.
- Do NOT claim whether work was completed, shipped, or not shipped. You have no source for that. Do not state or imply it either way.
- Reminders: render the injected REMINDERS block verbatim, preserving each issue as a single clickable markdown-link line (`- [DEV-338 · 53d · Techy Things · Title](https://...)`). Do not split into an ID line plus a separate raw URL line, do not abbreviate to `[URL]`, and do not omit any link. If it says 'None flagged' (e.g. token not configured), write 'None flagged' and never invent time-sensitive items.

Output format:

### Weather & Reminders

**Weather & Reminders**
*   **Weather (Cambridge, VT):** <Now>. <Today>. <Tomorrow> - from the injected context only; never invent or generalize a forecast
*   **Reminders:** <stale open Linear issues, each with its full URL on its own line under this line; or "None flagged">

### Work Priorities
- Current focus areas only, drawn from the profile. No completion claims.

### Issues / Blockers
- Red-cross items from the scan only
- Anything needing attention, or "Nothing blocking."

Keep it concise. No fluff. Direct format.

jobs.name: Brief - Midday
jobs.prompt:
Produce a polished Midday Check. This is a DELTA report: compare against the morning brief's output and the injected brief context, and report only what changed.

The measured brief context (weather, infra scan) is injected above under the "===== BRIEF CONTEXT =====" header. Treat that as your ONLY source.

HARD RULES
- Weather: report only values present in the injected context, compared against the morning brief's values. If it says WEATHER SOURCE UNAVAILABLE, say the outlook is unavailable. Never invent.
- Do NOT claim that no work was completed. You cannot observe that. If nothing changed in the injected context, write "No change detected".
- Infra: only red-cross items are issues. "Known-inactive by design" entries are not issues.

Output format:

Weather Delta
- Change vs the morning values, or "No change"

Work Status
- Focus areas unchanged, or a change visible in the injected context. No completion claims.

Issues / New Blockers
- New red-cross items; resolution status on earlier flags

Keep it short. No recap of unchanged items.

jobs.name: Brief - Evening
jobs.prompt:
Produce a polished End-of-Day Wrap. Compare against the day's earlier briefs and the injected brief context.

The measured brief context (weather, infra scan) is injected above under the "===== BRIEF CONTEXT =====" header. Treat that as your ONLY source.

HARD RULES
- Weather: report only values present in the injected context. If it says WEATHER SOURCE UNAVAILABLE, say the outlook is unavailable. Never invent.
- Do NOT state what shipped or did not ship. You cannot observe that. Report only what changed in the injected context.
- Infra: only red-cross items are issues. "Known-inactive by design" entries are not issues.

Output format:

Weather Today
- Final conditions, from the injected context

Day Summary
- What changed on the machine, per the injected context
- Open items carried to tomorrow: if the injected REMINDERS block lists stale issues, surface them as single clickable markdown-link lines (`- [DEV-338 · 53d · Techy Things · Title](https://...)`), verbatim and one per line. Do not split into an ID line plus a separate raw URL line, abbreviate to `[URL]`, or omit links.

Issues / Carry-forwards
- Red-cross items and port changes since morning
- Recommended first actions

Keep it tight. One-line verdicts preferred. No fluff.

jobs.name: Gmail Daily Triage
jobs.prompt:
Run email triage on Gmail inbox. This is a self-contained script execution:

1. Set PATH and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"` and `export GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD="$(grep '^GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD=' ~/.hermes/.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')"` (from ~/.hermes/.env)

2. Run with limit 10: `EMAIL_TRIAGE_LIMIT=10 python3 ~/.hermes/skills/email/email-triage-agent/scripts/triage.py run`

3. After it finishes, review the staged drafts with `python3 ~/.hermes/skills/email/email-triage-agent/scripts/triage.py review`.

4. Report: total emails processed, classification breakdown, staged draft count, any errors. Do NOT send anything — just triage and stage.

PATH FACTS — state these verbatim, never paraphrase or invent:
- Staged drafts live in ~/.hermes/email-drafts (i.e. /Users/macstudio/.hermes/email-drafts). That is the ONLY draft directory. Never cite any other path for drafts.
- Copy file paths into the report exactly as the script prints them. If the script did not print a path, do not state one.

STAGING SEMANTICS:
- Only action, reply and urgent-reply threads are staged as draft files. noise, reference and waiting threads are appended to classified.log and are NOT staged.
- Report the staged draft count the script prints, not the number of threads processed. Do not describe a logged thread as staged.

CLASSIFICATION HYGIENE:
- For any thread classified action, reply, or urgent-reply, read the message body before reporting what it asks for. Say explicitly whether the staged draft is safe to send.
- Never report that an email needs a reply if its body says the inbox is unmonitored / "do not reply". Report it as a false positive and recommend discarding the draft with: python3 ~/.hermes/skills/email/email-triage-agent/scripts/triage.py discard <envelope_id>
